On the ninth day of fog he found a green bottle wedged between two stones, its cork sealed with candle wax. Inside was a single page, the ink faded to brown. It was written by a woman named Ada, who had kept this same light forty years before. She described the third stair that creaked, the draft that whistled through the lantern room, the loneliness of long winters. At the bottom she had written: if you are reading this, you are not the first, and you will not be the last. Elias climbed the stairs that night, stepping carefully over the third one.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有醒来。路灯把空荡荡的街道照成昏黄色，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，轮胎碾过积水，声音很快消失在远处。便利店的灯一直亮着，店员趴在柜台上打盹。环卫工人推着车，扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。高楼里只剩几扇窗户还亮着，也许有人在加班，也许有人失眠。早点铺的老板已经开始揉面，蒸笼里冒出第一缕白气。天边仍是深蓝色，再过一会儿，城市就会慢慢醒来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Picture a stack of nesting dolls: to find the smallest one, you open a doll and do the same thing with the doll inside.\n- You keep going until you reach a doll that won't open, and that stopping point is what keeps recursion from going on forever."}
